Indian Railway Decorates 1AC Train for Suhagraat with Unconventional Design

The Indian Railways has decorated a first-class train coupe with flowers, balloons, and fairy lights to resemble a honeymoon suite. The unusual design has sparked debate on social media about whether the railway permits such decorations. This incident highlights the creative ways in which public spaces are being utilized for special occasions.
